subject: Will I be warned if my apps are nearing account limit for usage?

messages.author: 9f11f192732e869e
messages.subject: Will I be warned if my apps are nearing account limit for usage?
parts:
I have a free account, which I understand imposes a limit of 25 active hours per month. I recently checked on my apps' usage and was surprised to see that one is already at 63 hours in the "current cycle" (50 in the past week). However, the app does not seem to have been disabled. 

My question is: Given that this app already seems to have surpassed the usage limit, will I receive any warning before it becomes disabled? Or does the "Usage" tab not correspond to the "active hours" that contribute toward the 25-hour limit?

Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Will I be warned if my apps are nearing account limit for usage?
parts: We send an e-mail notification before suspending an account. If the subscription cycle end date is before we would take action on the suspension, however, we don't bother sending the notification. So it is likely that in your case all that usage was at the tail end of the cycle, and you will get a new set of 25 hours. If you consume that early in the cycle, you can expect to receive the notification.
